blocks.text: Profiling and optimization help improve the speed and efficiency of a program. Profiling measures how much time and resources each part of the code uses. Optimization focuses on making slow or resource-heavy parts faster. These techniques are important for building high-performance applications. Regular profiling ensures that code remains efficient as it grows.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
